title: Schematify registers through one Tauri module and one generate_handler! line
context: Alternative approaches: individual `#[tauri::command]` for each operation; multiple registrations; unregistered dispatch.
decision: Schematify registers through a single module `src-tauri/src/apps/schematify.rs` and adds one line to `generate_handler!`. Every further command lands inside that module as a match arm on the method string (e.g., `schematify/open-project`). No separate `#[tauri::command]` entries or `src/bindings.ts` wrappers are added.
consequences: Minimal collision on shared registration files; merge contention is limited to one line in `generate_handler!` and the schematify.rs file; all 10 operations share one dispatch function; typed wrappers live in `apps/schematify/ui/src/rpc.ts` instead of the shell's `bindings.ts`.
